notes.title: Add English language pack for Ver1.5 and fix some known bugs
notes.content:
New Features:
1.Added English language pack.
Bug Fixes:
1.Fixed a major bug where speed points could not be increased when the option to hide card recycling prompts was set.
2.Fixed a minor bug during the engraving of the magic circle.
3.Fixed some minor interface bugs.
